name: suede-rights-passport
description: Suede Labs skill that turns messy creator materials into a local, offline rights-and-provenance transfer package: inventoried and hashed assets, a normalized suede-intake.json manifest, credits and splits, license notes, provenance, and a missing-information report, validated by a bundled stdlib script. Use when a creator needs to hand a song, release, or project to a collaborator, advisor, registry, marketplace, or label; when someone asks for a rights package, intake package, or handoff folder
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一款本地离线整理工具，可将零散创作资料生成规范的版权与来源交接包，适合歌曲或项目对外合作、登记和发行。
